body.note:
Scarborough volumes arriving into a US$100 oil tape, paid out at 80% fully franked. Brent above US$100 against a 1H26 realised price of US$74/boe points to second-half earnings upside. 

Scarborough delivered first gas on 29 July with first LNG targeted for Q4 2026, lifting volumes into 2027. An 80% payout, fully franked. Browse equity rising to 41.27% and Louisiana LNG (28% complete, with Stonepeak funding) are long-dated growth options.
